"""Edge case and validation tests."""
import json, subprocess, sys, copy

RUN = ['/workspace/submission/run.sh']

def run(lines):
    data = '\n'.join(lines)
    p = subprocess.run(RUN, input=data.encode('utf-8'), capture_output=True, timeout=200)
    assert p.returncode == 0, (p.returncode, p.stderr[-2000:])
    out = p.stdout.decode()
    return [json.loads(l) for l in out.splitlines()], p.stderr.decode()

fails = []
def check(label, got, want):
    if got != want:
        fails.append((label, got, want))
        print('FAIL', label, 'got', json.dumps(got)[:200], 'want', json.dumps(want)[:200])
    else:
        print('ok  ', label)

# --- malformed JSON ---
res, err = run(['', '{', '[]', '{"a":1,}', 'NaN', '{"id":"x","version":1}',
                '{"id":"x","version":1,"nodes":["A","B"],"edges":[],"commodities":[],"domains":[],"max_faults":0,"snapshots":[{"id":"s","bounds":[],"controller":[],"tolerance":0,"observations":[]}]}'])
base = {'id': None, 'status': 'error', 'error': 'malformed_json'}
okbase = {'id': 'x', 'status': 'unique', 'min_faults': 0, 'faults': {'forced': [], 'possible': []},
          'snapshots': [{'id': 's', 'demands': [], 'links': [], 'verdict': 'consistent'}],
          'witness': {'demands': [], 'links': [], 'faults': []}, 'alternative': None}
check('blank line', res[0], base)
check('brace', res[1], base)
check('array top', res[2], {'id': None, 'status': 'error', 'error': 'invalid_instance'})
check('trailing comma', res[3], base)
check('NaN literal', res[4], base)
check('missing fields', res[5], {'id': 'x', 'status': 'error', 'error': 'invalid_instance'})
check('valid minimal', res[6], okbase)

# NaN / Infinity inside nested values
res, _ = run(['{"id":"n","version":1,"ignored":NaN}', '{"id":"n","version":1,"ignored":[Infinity]}',
              '{"id":"n","version":1,"ignored":-Infinity}'])
for i, r in enumerate(res):
    check('nan/infinity %d' % i, r, base)

# non-object tops
res, _ = run(['1', '"str"', 'true', 'null'])
for i, r in enumerate(res):
    check('scalar %d' % i, r, {'id': None, 'status': 'error', 'error': 'invalid_instance'})

# --- id echoing ---
res, _ = run(['{"id":123,"version":9}', '{"id":"good-name_1","version":9}',
              '{"id":"x"*1}'.replace('*1',''), '{"id":"a"*40,"version":1}'.replace('*40', '+' + '"'+'a'*40+'"'),
              '{"version":1}', '{"id":"ok","version":1,"nodes":["A","B"],"edges":[{"id":"e","source":"A","target":"B","capacity":true}],"commodities":[],"domains":[],"max_faults":0,"snapshots":[{"id":"s","bounds":[],"controller":[],"tolerance":0,"observations":[]}]}'])
check('bad version numeric id', res[0], {'id': None, 'status': 'error', 'error': 'invalid_instance'})
check('bad version good id', res[1], {'id': 'good-name_1', 'status': 'error', 'error': 'invalid_instance'})
check('too long id', res[3], {'id': None, 'status': 'error', 'error': 'invalid_instance'})
check('missing id', res[4], {'id': None, 'status': 'error', 'error': 'invalid_instance'})
check('bool capacity', res[5], {'id': 'ok', 'status': 'error', 'error': 'invalid_instance'})

# --- schema violations ---
def base_inst():
    return {'id': 't', 'version': 1, 'nodes': ['A', 'B'],
            'edges': [{'id': 'e', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 10}],
            'commodities': [], 'domains': [], 'max_faults': 0,
            'snapshots': [{'id': 's', 'bounds': [], 'controller': [], 'tolerance': 0,
                           'observations': []}]}

def expect_invalid(label, mutate):
    inst = base_inst()
    mutate(inst)
    res, _ = run([json.dumps(inst)])
    check(label, res[0], {'id': 't', 'status': 'error', 'error': 'invalid_instance'})

expect_invalid('nodes 1', lambda i: i.__setitem__('nodes', ['A']))
expect_invalid('nodes dup', lambda i: i.__setitem__('nodes', ['A', 'A']))
expect_invalid('nodes 13', lambda i: i.__setitem__('nodes', ['n%d' % k for k in range(13)]))
expect_invalid('bad node name', lambda i: i.__setitem__('nodes', ['A', '1B']))
expect_invalid('edges 33', lambda i: i.__setitem__('edges', [
    {'id': 'e%d' % k, 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 1} for k in range(33)]))
expect_invalid('edge dup id', lambda i: i.__setitem__('edges', [
    {'id': 'e', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 1},
    {'id': 'e', 'source': 'B', 'target': 'A', 'capacity': 1}]))
expect_invalid('edge unknown node', lambda i: i.__setitem__('edges', [
    {'id': 'e', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'Z', 'capacity': 1}]))
expect_invalid('edge self loop', lambda i: i.__setitem__('edges', [
    {'id': 'e', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'A', 'capacity': 1}]))
expect_invalid('edge cap 1000001', lambda i: i.__setitem__('edges', [
    {'id': 'e', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 1000001}]))
expect_invalid('edge cap negative', lambda i: i.__setitem__('edges', [
    {'id': 'e', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': -1}]))
expect_invalid('edge cap float', lambda i: i.__setitem__('edges', [
    {'id': 'e', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 1.0}]))
expect_invalid('edge cap string', lambda i: i.__setitem__('edges', [
    {'id': 'e', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': '5'}]))
expect_invalid('no snapshots', lambda i: i.__setitem__('snapshots', []))
expect_invalid('snap dup id', lambda i: i.__setitem__('snapshots', [
    {'id': 's', 'bounds': [], 'controller': [], 'tolerance': 0, 'observations': []},
    {'id': 's', 'bounds': [], 'controller': [], 'tolerance': 0, 'observations': []}]))
expect_invalid('tolerance 10001', lambda i: i['snapshots'][0].__setitem__('tolerance', 10001))
expect_invalid('tolerance negative', lambda i: i['snapshots'][0].__setitem__('tolerance', -1))
expect_invalid('bounds wrong len', lambda i: i['snapshots'][0].__setitem__('bounds', [[0, 1]]))
expect_invalid('bounds hi>lo', lambda i: i['snapshots'][0].__setitem__('bounds', [[5, 1]]) if False else i['snapshots'][0].__setitem__('controller', []))
expect_invalid('max_faults > domains', lambda i: i.__setitem__('max_faults', 1))
expect_invalid('max_faults negative', lambda i: i.__setitem__('max_faults', -1))
expect_invalid('domains 15', lambda i: (i.__setitem__('domains', ['d%d' % k for k in range(15)]),
                                        i.__setitem__('max_faults', 15)))
expect_invalid('domains dup', lambda i: (i.__setitem__('domains', ['d', 'd']),
                                         i.__setitem__('max_faults', 1)))

# commodities
def with_com(routes, **kw):
    inst = base_inst()
    inst['commodities'] = [{'id': 'c', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'routes': routes}]
    inst['snapshots'][0]['bounds'] = [[0, 5]]
    inst['snapshots'][0]['controller'] = [0]
    return inst

def expect_invalid_c(label, routes):
    res, _ = run([json.dumps(with_com(routes))])
    check(label, res[0], {'id': 't', 'status': 'error', 'error': 'invalid_instance'})

expect_invalid_c('no routes', [])
expect_invalid_c('4 routes', [
    {'edges': ['e'], 'weight': 1}, {'edges': ['e'], 'weight': 1},
    {'edges': ['e'], 'weight': 1}, {'edges': ['e'], 'weight': 1}])
expect_invalid_c('weight 0', [{'edges': ['e'], 'weight': 0}])
expect_invalid_c('weight 9', [{'edges': ['e'], 'weight': 9}])
expect_invalid_c('weights sum 9', [{'edges': ['e'], 'weight': 5}, {'edges': ['e'], 'weight': 4}])
expect_invalid_c('weights sum 8 ok', [{'edges': ['e'], 'weight': 5}, {'edges': ['e'], 'weight': 3}])
expect_invalid_c('unknown edge', [{'edges': ['zz'], 'weight': 1}])
expect_invalid_c('empty edges', [{'edges': [], 'weight': 1}])
expect_invalid_c('weight float', [{'edges': ['e'], 'weight': 1.5}])

# route connectivity: need a 3 node chain
inst = base_inst()
inst['nodes'] = ['A', 'B', 'C']
inst['edges'] = [{'id': 'ab', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 5},
                 {'id': 'bc', 'source': 'B', 'target': 'C', 'capacity': 5},
                 {'id': 'cb', 'source': 'C', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 5}]
inst['commodities'] = [{'id': 'c', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'C',
                        'routes': [{'edges': ['ab', 'bc'], 'weight': 1}]}]
inst['snapshots'][0]['bounds'] = [[0, 5]]
inst['snapshots'][0]['controller'] = [0]
res, _ = run([json.dumps(inst)])
check('valid 2-hop route', res[0]['status'], 'unique')

bad = copy.deepcopy(inst)
bad['commodities'][0]['routes'][0]['edges'] = ['ab']
res, _ = run([json.dumps(bad)])
check('route stops early', res[0], {'id': 't', 'status': 'error', 'error': 'invalid_instance'})

bad = copy.deepcopy(inst)
bad['commodities'][0]['routes'][0]['edges'] = ['ab', 'cb']
res, _ = run([json.dumps(bad)])
check('route wrong direction', res[0], {'id': 't', 'status': 'error', 'error': 'invalid_instance'})

bad = copy.deepcopy(inst)
bad['commodities'][0]['routes'][0]['edges'] = ['ab', 'bc', 'cb']
res, _ = run([json.dumps(bad)])
check('route revisits node', res[0], {'id': 't', 'status': 'error', 'error': 'invalid_instance'})

bad = copy.deepcopy(inst)
bad['commodities'].append({'id': 'c2', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'C',
                           'routes': [{'edges': ['ab', 'bc'], 'weight': 1}]})
res, _ = run([json.dumps(bad)])
check('duplicate od pair', res[0], {'id': 't', 'status': 'error', 'error': 'invalid_instance'})

# observations
def with_obs(o):
    inst = base_inst()
    inst['commodities'] = [{'id': 'c', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B',
                            'routes': [{'edges': ['e'], 'weight': 1}]}]
    inst['snapshots'][0]['bounds'] = [[0, 5]]
    inst['snapshots'][0]['controller'] = [0]
    inst['snapshots'][0]['observations'] = [o]
    return inst

def expect_invalid_o(label, o):
    res, _ = run([json.dumps(with_obs(o))])
    check(label, res[0], {'id': 't', 'status': 'error', 'error': 'invalid_instance'})

expect_invalid_o('bad metric', {'id': 'o', 'metric': 'flow', 'target': 'c', 'lower': 0, 'upper': 1, 'domain': None})
expect_invalid_o('unknown target', {'id': 'o', 'metric': 'demand', 'target': 'zz', 'lower': 0, 'upper': 1, 'domain': None})
expect_invalid_o('link target is node', {'id': 'o', 'metric': 'link', 'target': 'A', 'lower': 0, 'upper': 1, 'domain': None})
expect_invalid_o('demand target is edge', {'id': 'o', 'metric': 'demand', 'target': 'e', 'lower': 0, 'upper': 1, 'domain': None})
expect_invalid_o('lower > upper', {'id': 'o', 'metric': 'demand', 'target': 'c', 'lower': 5, 'upper': 1, 'domain': None})
expect_invalid_o('domain unlisted', {'id': 'o', 'metric': 'demand', 'target': 'c', 'lower': 0, 'upper': 1, 'domain': 'nope'})
expect_invalid_o('lower -1000001', {'id': 'o', 'metric': 'demand', 'target': 'c', 'lower': -1000001, 'upper': 1, 'domain': None})
expect_invalid_o('upper 1000001', {'id': 'o', 'metric': 'demand', 'target': 'c', 'lower': 0, 'upper': 1000001, 'domain': None})
expect_invalid_o('obs id noname', {'id': '1o', 'metric': 'demand', 'target': 'c', 'lower': 0, 'upper': 1, 'domain': None})

# duplicate observation ids in one snapshot
res, _ = run([json.dumps(with_obs({'id': 'o', 'metric': 'demand', 'target': 'c', 'lower': 0, 'upper': 1, 'domain': None})).replace('"id": "o"', '"id": "o"') for _ in range(1)])
inst = with_obs({'id': 'o', 'metric': 'demand', 'target': 'c', 'lower': 0, 'upper': 1, 'domain': None})
inst['snapshots'][0]['observations'].append({'id': 'o', 'metric': 'demand', 'target': 'c', 'lower': 0, 'upper': 2, 'domain': None})
res, _ = run([json.dumps(inst)])
check('dup obs ids', res[0], {'id': 't', 'status': 'error', 'error': 'invalid_instance'})

print()
if fails:
    print('%d FAILURES' % len(fails))
    sys.exit(1)
print('ALL EDGE TESTS PASSED')
PYEOF
